author: tvami
body:
#### PR description:

Opening this as RFC. The physics discussion is happening at 
https://indico.cern.ch/event/1733209/#8-first-implementation-and-fir

This PR adds Geant4 simulation of quirks to SimG4Core/CustomPhysics: heavy charged fermions bound in pairs by a string of constant tension, with each quirk stepped analytically under the string and Lorentz forces and the two quirks of a pair tracked in alternation. It is enabled only when g4SimHits.Physics.QuirkMass > 0, so existing workflows are unchanged, and it comes with a Pythia8 Drell-Yan fragment with an optional generator filter on the pair direction and a unit test.

This code has been ported from Athena `Simulation/G4Extensions/Quirks` package and has been adapted to CMS constraints.

#### PR validation:

I'll show a lot of plots in https://indico.cern.ch/event/1733209/#8-first-implementation-and-fir including technical ones too. 

 * Oscillation amplitude and period match the analytic values to 2e-5, and 4-momentum is conserved to 2e-10.
 * Run 3 GEN-SIM-DIGI-HLT-RECO for Lambda = 30 eV to 30 keV (200 events, 1 and 4 threads): exactly two quirk SimTracks per event; in the Lambda -> 0 limit the results match the charge-1 HIP.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

This is not a backport, but we should discuss about backports for Run-2 / Run-3 searches.
title: [RFC] Add quirk simulation to CustomPhysics
